checks: Vertex support is equivalent to independence of columns (1,q). A dependent support permits a signed two-sided perturbation, while nonnegativity forces any two vectors averaging to an independent-support point to have the same support subset. Integer minors give rational coefficients and rank controls the support size. Finite p and support sets give a single denominator.

Support elimination gives a finite convex decomposition. The first independent sublist with closed convex hull containing the row vector gives Borel barycentric coefficients. The self-template is extreme and every other extreme template has zero self weight.

Disintegration is on compact standard Borel supports. Positive target-base conditional means lie in the appropriate face by convexity and the normal equality. For each used template the support sum is at most h_p by compatibility, and their average is h_p by the martingale moment. Hence each used sum is tight, yielding inclusion of the entire Minkowski face sum.

The lift of each original q-branch has weight θ_r α_q/w_q. It is at most one and the sum over r is one on that branch because its input marginal is w_q ν. The full original input-output law is therefore recovered upon forgetting the intermediate mark.

The first-stage continuous average is the original x. For the second stage the r,q marginal and moment are θ_r α_q ν and θ_r α_q y_q ν. Testing at the intermediate handles collisions of original inputs with equal marks, giving fixed target base probabilities and the correct barycenter.

The integer interpretation scales the anchored equations and face inclusion by D. Extremality forces all positive intermediate points to equal the original x. The source locators 7959b9ecad75ca36 §§1–4 and §6 were checked. The normalization uses conditional probabilities for the same moment construction.

overlap.comparison: Uses affinely independent anchored supports for a volume-packing optimization and preserves or improves its cost. It does not split every row of a fixed given marked coupling while preserving its entire joint law.

Gives active anchored row probabilities for a physical martingale on actual regular boundaries. The new proof starts with a same-normal martingale even on nonsmooth support faces and refines every row by a finite rational list.

readability: The triple refinement retains original input-output dependence. Composing just the projected stages as Markov kernels need not retain that dependence at colliding intermediate marks.
review_method: Independent mathematical proof review of the frozen normalized candidate
summary: The original marked coupling has a measurable finite-template refinement that keeps its full input-output law and realizes the stated two martingale stages.
